moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio ui-press, written here): Pill 140x48 r24. Press at 0.6 s: scale 1 → 0.95 over 80 ms power2.out (data: 80-120 ms, easeOutQuad); held until 0.75 s; release: back to 1 on a spring k300 c14 (≈ 1.3 % overshoot, settled by ≈ 0.5 s); recipe variant: 200 ms back.out. The cursor arrives from 60 px right / 40 px below over 0.1-0.55 s power2.out and shows its pressed state while held. Params: at · hold (0.15 s) · down (0.95, 0.08 s) · release (lò xo k300 c14 | 0.2 s back.out). The recipe's variant releases with 0.2 s back.out.
